Export these variables in your current shell session so subsequent commands (in that session) can access them. 4. Print the values of all three environment variables to a file named /home/user/db_config/query_optimization.log in the following *exact* format: DB_HOST: [value] DB_USER: [value] QUERY_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL: [value] (where [value] is the value of each variable as set above). Make sure that the log file has each variable on its own line as specified, and no additional content is present. If you need to verify your work, check that the variable values are correctly written to /home/user/db_config/query_optimization.log in the format described above.
